name: The name behind the papers

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Elling identifies Dashel Stonefist as the next lead.
description: Elling studies the docket and finds a name he recognizes: Dashel Stonefist, a resident of Stormwind’s Old Town. Backus had seen the papers; Elling can follow them. That distinction turns a cache of documents into a human lead. The investigation returns to the city not because the danger has passed, but because its next door is hidden among familiar streets and guarded reputations.
